These CORE requirements have no task covering them yet (a task covers a requirement by listing its id in requirement_ids):
- R-001: Native SwiftUI iOS client backed by a real, separately-deployed backend service (not local-only/offline) reachable from the device.
- R-002: Auth flow with session persistence across force-quit — a fresh account can sign in and returning users resume signed-in state.
- R-003: Zero-state onboarding never dead-ends: a user with no pod can always create a pod or join one via invite code/link.
- R-004: Trust-graph/pod membership is enforced as a hard filter on all request read/write operations — no non-member visibility or mutation.
- R-005: Posting a same-day relay request contains no child PII (no name/photo/face fields).
- R-006: Post confirmation shows honest delivery-count copy ('Sent to N pod members') based on real push-token/registration status, with a warning when delivery looks uncertain.
- R-007: Server-side event handling must commit the CAS write and submit the APNs payload within a strict, server-owned bound (target: <=2s happy-path from action receipt). End-to-end device receipt is required to be demonstrated in the two-device demo but is an observed outcome subject to Apple push infrastructure variance, not a hard contractual pass/fail metric.
- R-008: Data model supports multiple simultaneously-open requests per pod, each independently identified and acceptable.
- R-009: Accept arbitration uses a genuine server-side compare-and-swap write; polling or client-side arbitration is not used as a stand-in.
- R-010: Concurrent accepts from two devices resolve deterministically to exactly one confirmed winner and one explicit 'already covered by [name]' loser, sourced from the CAS write result.
- R-011: No optimistic UI confirmation anywhere: post/accept/release/complete/withdraw all show an explicit awaiting-confirmation state until real backend acknowledgment.
- R-012: Release ('I can no longer cover this') is available only to the current accepter, reopens the request, and re-notifies the pod within roughly 30 seconds.
- R-013: A requester-only 'withdrawn' terminal state exists for open/still-open/reopened unclaimed requests, arbitrated via the same CAS path, triggers a re-notify, and never produces an audit/receipt artifact.
- R-014: 'Withdrawn' and 'release' are mutually exclusive by state — only one is ever visible/available to a given user for a given request.
- R-015: An unfulfilled request shows a visible, numeric elapsed-time 'still open' state with a re-broadcast action, never a static pending label.
